name: AlQuran Cloud API
description: Comprehensive RESTful Quran API and CDN providing all 114 surahs, individual ayahs, juzs, pages, hizbs, manzils, and rukus across 80+ translations, multiple Arabic scripts, and verse-by-verse audio recitations. Completely free and keyless.

authentication.description: Public, open API. No authentication or API keys required.

rateLimit.policy: Open access. Caching is strongly recommended for static text and audio files.

endpoints.name: List All Surahs
endpoints.description: Returns metadata for all 114 Surahs (number, Arabic name, English name, translation, revelation type, number of ayahs).

endpoints.name: Get Surah by Number
endpoints.description: Returns a complete Surah in standard Arabic Uthmani text.

endpoints.name: Get Surah by Edition(s)
endpoints.description: Returns a Surah in a specific text, translation, or audio edition. Supports multiple comma-separated editions (e.g. 'quran-uthmani,en.asad,ar.alafasy').

endpoints.name: Get Ayah by Reference
endpoints.description: Fetches a single Ayah by absolute global index (1-6236) or surah:ayah key (e.g. 2:255).

endpoints.name: Get Ayah by Edition
endpoints.description: Fetches a single Ayah for a specific translation or recitation edition.

endpoints.name: Get Ayah Across Multiple Editions
endpoints.description: Returns an ayah across multiple comma-separated editions.

endpoints.name: Get Random Ayah
endpoints.description: Fetches a random verse from the Quran.

endpoints.name: Get Juz
endpoints.description: Retrieves an entire Juz (1 to 30) for a specific edition.

endpoints.name: Get Mushaf Page
endpoints.description: Retrieves verses on a specific Medina Mushaf page (1 to 604).

endpoints.name: List All Editions
endpoints.description: Lists all available translations, Arabic scripts, transliterations, and audio recitations with format, language, and type filters.

endpoints.name: Search Quran
endpoints.description: Searches for a word or phrase within a specific Surah (or 'all' for the whole Quran) using a chosen edition.

endpoints.name: Get Quran Metadata
endpoints.description: Returns structural metadata for all Surahs, Pages, Hizbs, Quarters, and Juzs.
